title: Longformer: The Long-Document Transformer
evidence_note: Read attention-pattern sections, including symmetric task-designated global positions and bounded-window scaling; distinguished bidirectional document processing from causal decoder use.

title: Big Bird: Transformers for Longer Sequences
evidence_note: Read graph construction and local/random/global connection descriptions; theoretical expressivity is not a guarantee of practical exact recall.

title: MoBA: Mixture of Block Attention for Long-Context LLMs
evidence_note: Read §2 routing equations and causality handling: query dot mean-key block scores, original token-level KV read in selected blocks, mandatory current block with causal masking, and sparse/full-attention mixtures.

title: MInference 1.0: Accelerating Pre-filling for Long-Context LLMs via Dynamic Sparse Attention
evidence_note: Read §§2–3 and evaluation methodology: offline head-pattern assignment, static A-shape and dynamic Vertical-Slash/Block-Sparse indices, training-free approximate prefill attention.

title: Native Sparse Attention: Hardware-Aligned and Natively Trainable Sparse Attention
evidence_note: Read §3: learned overlapping block summaries; compression-score-derived block selection aggregated across shared KV query groups; independent KV representations and gated combination of compression, selection and local branches.

title: DeepSeek-V3.2: Pushing the Frontier of Open Large Language Models
evidence_note: Read §§2.1–2.3: learned lightning indexer, top-k MLA entry selection, dense indexer warm-up and sparse continued training; main attention O(Nk) while full-sequence indexer remains O(N²).

title: DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model
evidence_note: Read §2.1 joint latent KV compression and decoupled positional component; MLA reduces entry dimensions but still retains a learned record per historical position.

title: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
evidence_note: Read §2.3 and §4.2: overlapping 2r-source-position CSA windows emitted every r positions, HCA non-overlapping dense compressed-history access, shared-KV MQA with the same entry as key and value, and local uncompressed entries.

title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro official inference/model.py
evidence_note: Inspected Compressor, Indexer and Attention implementations: overlap transform, per-channel softmax pooling, incomplete-block state, causal compressed-entry indices, and concatenation of local and compressed entries for the core attention.

title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro official inference/config.json
evidence_note: Checked compression ratios 4 and 128, local window 128, and per-layer ratio list with two initial HCA layers and subsequent interleaving; avoid interpreting pooled-record counts as full memory footprints.

title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro official model card
evidence_note: Read model introduction and long-context evaluation tables, including MRCR and CorpusQA; whole-model results do not isolate a compressor's contribution.
